title: Quantitative non-embeddability theorems and metric embeddings of slit carpets
summary: We study the bi-Lipschitz embedding problem for a class of metric spaces called slit carpets. First we show that the $n$th stage $\mathbb{M}_n$ of the standard slit carpet of Merenkov admits a bi-Lipschitz embedding into Euclidean space with distortion $ O(\sqrt{n})$. Then, we show a nearly sharp lower bound of $Ω\left(\sqrt{\frac{n}{\log(n)}}\right)$.
